subject: dsa
title: Reorder List
summary: Three moves: find the middle, reverse the second half, then weave the two halves together one node at a time.
problem: Reorder the list so it runs first, last, second, second-last, ..., i.e. L0, Ln, L1, Ln-1, ...

steps.caption: Reorder so it alternates front, back, front, back: 1, 4, 2, 3. Do it in three moves: find the middle, reverse the back, then weave.
Move 1: find the middle with slow/fast pointers. Slow stops at 2, splitting the list into front [1, 2] and back [3, 4].
Move 2: reverse the back half in place, so 3 -> 4 becomes 4 -> 3. Now the front runs 1 -> 2 and the back runs 4 -> 3.
Move 3: weave the halves. Take front's head 1, then back's head 4, and link 1 -> 4.
Continue the weave: after 4 comes front's next node 2, then back's next node 3. Link 4 -> 2 -> 3.
Every node is placed. The reordered list is 1 -> 4 -> 2 -> 3.
